cutoff.meaning: The end of the council's regular session on 8 September 2026, by which time the vote must have occurred.

negative_condition: Ordinance 2026-14 does not receive at least three affirmative votes at the 8 September session (including failure, tie, or adoption at a later session).
positive_condition: Ordinance 2026-14 receives at least three affirmative votes at the 8 September session.

proof.meaning: The official record of the vote on Ordinance 2026-14 at the 8 September session, showing each council member's vote.
proof.name: vote_record
proof.subject: Ordinance 2026-14

terminal_meaning: The question resolves based on whether Ordinance 2026-14 receives at least three affirmative votes from the five-member council at the 8 September 2026 regular session.
